entities.name: Druim Calad
entities.description: The only major aboveground port in Shadowmoor, built on a collapsed city's remains near a sinkhole; home to about 300 residents, mostly merrow.

entities.name: Myyn
entities.description: Merrow leader of the Finblade network of cutthroats who claims to rule Druim Calad and owns the Red Shallows tavern.

entities.name: Finblade
entities.description: A network of cutthroats led by Myyn.

entities.name: The Red Shallows
entities.description: Myyn's tavern, just above the water in Druim Calad.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description: The majority species in Druim Calad, who do most of their trading there.
